## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it.
*Example: "I am always frustrated when..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

## Alternative Approaches Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## UI / UX Mockups (Optional)
If applicable, describe or sketch how this feature should look in the desktop dashboard or mobile web client.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, technical references, or links regarding the feature request here.
